meta.description: Answers to common questions about course enrollment, lifetime access, certificates, payments, refunds, and corporate training.

hero.title: Frequently Asked Questions
hero.subtitle: Answers to the most common questions about courses, payments, certificates, and corporate training.

cta.title: Couldn't find your answer?
cta.subtitle: Our team is happy to help.

items.question: What is Thorius?
items.answer: Thorius Education and Consulting offers an integrated transformation model that begins with consulting and audit, continues with AI4U Retail software, Thorius Academy training, publishing & library, and coaching. For details, visit /hakkimizda.

items.question: Is Thorius Academy the same as the company?
items.answer: Yes. Thorius Academy is the online learning platform of Thorius Education and Consulting Ltd. Company credentials and official documents are on /hakkimizda.

items.question: What training areas do you cover?
items.answer: We offer career-focused training in retail planning, human resources, and artificial intelligence. See the current catalog on /kurslar.

items.question: Are courses online or in person?
items.answer: Courses on Thorius Academy are online and self-paced. Corporate programs can include live sessions and customized content. We also offer in-person training for corporate clients.

items.question: How do I enroll in a course?
items.answer: Create a free account, choose your course, and complete checkout. Once access is confirmed, start from My Courses.

items.question: Are there free courses?
items.answer: Yes. The catalog includes free courses open to everyone. Featured courses on the homepage are curated by the Thorius team and may be free or paid — check the price on each course card.

items.question: How long do I have access to a course?
items.answer: Purchased or enrolled courses come with lifetime access. You can return and rewatch anytime.

items.question: Can I watch on my phone?
items.answer: Yes. The platform works on modern mobile and tablet browsers.

items.question: Can I download lessons?
items.answer: No. Videos and materials are streamed on the platform; file downloads are not offered.

items.question: Can I resume where I left off?
items.answer: Yes. Your progress is saved to your account so you can continue from the last lesson.

items.question: What payment methods do you accept?
items.answer: We accept credit and debit cards through a secure payment provider.

items.question: Are prices inclusive of VAT?
items.answer: Yes. Course prices are shown in Turkish Lira (TRY) and include applicable taxes.

items.question: Can I get a corporate invoice?
items.answer: Yes. Share your billing details at checkout or email info@thorius.com.tr afterward.

items.question: When do I get access after payment?
items.answer: Access opens after payment confirmation — usually instantly, and within 24 hours at the latest in My Courses.

items.question: Do I have a refund or withdrawal right?
items.answer: For digital content, you have a 14-day withdrawal right before course access begins. Once access starts, the right of withdrawal cannot be used. Details are in /mesafeli-satis.

items.question: How do I use a discount code?
items.answer: Enter your code in the coupon field at checkout. Valid codes apply automatically.

items.question: Do you issue certificates?
items.answer: Yes. Participants who complete all lessons and requirements receive a digital completion certificate.

items.question: How do I get my certificate?
items.answer: When you complete the course, your certificate is prepared; you'll be notified by email and can download it from your account.

items.question: Can certificates be verified?
items.answer: Yes. Validity can be checked using the verification code or QR on the certificate.

items.question: How do I create an account?
items.answer: Sign up for free with your email on the registration page. After email verification, you can sign in.

items.question: I forgot my password — what should I do?
items.answer: Use the “Forgot password” link on the sign-in page to request a reset email, then set a new password from the link.

items.question: I can't sign in.
items.answer: Check your email and password; try another browser or a private window. If the issue persists, email info@thorius.com.tr or message us on WhatsApp.

items.question: Video won't play.
items.answer: Check your internet connection; use an up-to-date Chrome, Safari, or Firefox. Ad blockers or VPNs can sometimes affect playback.

items.question: Can we get bulk training for our company?
items.answer: Yes. Share your team's needs via the contact form on /kurumsal and we'll prepare a tailored proposal. Form: /kurumsal#iletisim

items.question: What corporate packages are available?
items.answer: We offer Growth (50–200 employees) and Enterprise (200+ employees) packages. Seat count, live sessions, and custom content can be tailored.

items.question: Is it training only, or consulting too?
items.answer: The Thorius model starts with consulting and audit; it continues with AI4U Retail, Academy training, Library, and Coaching. See /kurumsal for details.

items.question: What is the Library?
items.answer: A separate platform (kitaplik.thorius.com.tr) for printed books and e-books from Thorius Publishing — distinct from Academy courses.

items.question: Can I download e-books?
items.answer: No. E-books are read in a secure reader; file downloads are not offered.

items.question: Do you have a publishing license?
items.answer: Yes. Our Ministry of Culture and Tourism approved publishing license is shown at /hakkimizda#belgelerimiz.

items.question: How is my personal data processed?
items.answer: Purposes, retention periods, and your rights are explained in our KVKK notice: /kvkk

items.question: What are the distance sales terms?
items.answer: Online course purchases are covered by our Distance Sales Agreement. Withdrawal, payment, and delivery terms are in /mesafeli-satis.

items.question: How can I reach you?
items.answer: info@thorius.com.tr · +90 543 132 35 03 (phone & WhatsApp) · /iletisim
